in_marathi.name: Ambarish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ambarish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ambarish is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘amba’ meaning sky and ‘rish’ meaning ruler or lord. This name is a reference to the mythological king of the same name who ruled over the heavens. It is a powerful and evocative name, filled with the majesty of the sky and the strength of a ruler.
